name: branch8-deepwiki
description: Adds DeepWiki (Cognition's free, no-auth MCP at mcp.deepwiki.com) as a knowledge source for public GitHub repositories, plus a skill that tells Claude when to consult it - how an open-source library or framework works internally, comparing libraries, debugging a third-party dependency - and how to query it without flooding the context. Public repos only; never sends company code.
